_comment: GPU pool config for the orchestrator. Each top-level key is '<cluster>/<gpu_type>'. The orchestrator reads this at import time; max_concurrency is overridden at runtime by src/r2c2_agent/slurm/gpu_calibration.json once the pool has been calibrated against the live workload. Add or remove pools by editing this file — no Python edits required.

baobab/a100_80.comment: 4× A100 80GB PCIe = 320GB total. Production teacher pool.

bamboo/bw6k.comment: 2× RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 48GB = 96GB. 16 CPUs + 128G matches h200 ratio so DeBERTa/MiniCheck CPU services don't starve.
